nodes.line: That's what I thought. That's exactly what I thought and nobody in Newtown would say it to my face. Ta.
Bag goes on the counter, love, not the floor. Welcome to Newtown.

choices.text: What is it you do round here?

nodes.line: I sort what Newtown throws out. Half of it is jeans, a quarter is a bread maker, and once a fortnight it's something someone will come back crying for.
One thing, and it's the king street order.
Show me. -- Maureen looks it over the way Newtown looks over a new cafe. -- That'll do. Here.
The good stuff at Black Star Pastry goes before ten. The people who know, know.
